LENOVO.setupKey: F1 (ThinkPad) / F2 or the Novo button (IdeaPad/Legion/Yoga)
LENOVO.notes: On ThinkPads, Enter at the logo shows the startup interrupt menu.

HP.notes: Press Esc at power-on for the startup menu.

Hewlett-Packard.notes: Press Esc at power-on for the startup menu.

Acer.bootMenuKey: F12 (enable 'F12 Boot Menu' in BIOS first)

Microsoft.setupKey: Hold Volume Up, then press and release Power
Microsoft.bootMenuKey: Hold Volume Down, then press Power
Microsoft.notes: Surface devices: in UEFI set Secure Boot to 'None'. Most Surface hardware (Wi-Fi, cameras, touch) is unsupported in macOS.

DEFAULT.setupKey: Del / F2 / F1 / Esc (check your manual)
DEFAULT.notes: HackWizard's 'Restart into BIOS' button works on any UEFI PC, so you don't need to know the key.

genericSettings.title: Secure Boot
genericSettings.why: OpenCore and its drivers are not signed with Microsoft's keys; the firmware will refuse to start them.
genericSettings.ifMissing: Some BIOSes require setting 'OS Type' to 'Other OS' or deleting the Secure Boot keys.

genericSettings.title: Boot mode
genericSettings.why: OpenCore is a UEFI application; CSM can break graphics initialisation.
genericSettings.ifMissing: If there is no CSM option your PC is already UEFI-only.

genericSettings.title: Fast Boot
genericSettings.why: Ensures USB is initialised so you can boot from it.

genericSettings.title: SATA mode
genericSettings.menuPath: Advanced → Storage / SATA Configuration → SATA Mode
genericSettings.why: macOS cannot see disks behind Intel RST/RAID.
genericSettings.ifMissing: On many laptops this is called 'RAID On' vs 'AHCI'. If Windows was installed in RAID mode it may need Safe Mode once — but you are erasing it anyway.

genericSettings.title: Intel VMD
genericSettings.menuPath: Advanced → Storage / VMD Setup → Enable VMD controller
genericSettings.why: VMD hides NVMe drives from macOS.

genericSettings.title: CFG Lock
genericSettings.menuPath: Advanced → Power & Performance → CPU Power Management → CFG Lock
genericSettings.why: Lets macOS manage CPU power states natively. HackWizard already enables the AppleXcpmCfgLock quirk, so this is optional.
genericSettings.ifMissing: Usually hidden on laptops; the quirk covers it.

genericSettings.title: VT-d
genericSettings.why: HackWizard sets DisableIoMapper so VT-d may stay on; disabling avoids issues on some boards.

genericSettings.title: DVMT Pre-Allocated
genericSettings.why: Intel iGPU drivers in macOS expect more than the common 32 MB default (HackWizard also patches this for laptops).
genericSettings.ifMissing: Usually hidden on laptops; the framebuffer patch covers it.

genericSettings.title: Integrated graphics
genericSettings.value: Enabled; primary display = PEG/PCIe if you use an AMD card
genericSettings.why: Keeps the iGPU available for Quick Sync while the AMD card drives the screens.

genericSettings.title: Above 4G Decoding
genericSettings.why: Required for modern GPUs; if the system will not boot with it on, also set Kernel → Quirks → npci (see Dortania).

genericSettings.title: Resizable BAR / Smart Access Memory
genericSettings.why: macOS does not use it and it can prevent booting.

genericSettings.title: XHCI Hand-off
genericSettings.why: Lets macOS take over the USB controllers.

genericSettings.title: UMA Frame Buffer Size
genericSettings.menuPath: Advanced → AMD CBS / Graphics → UMA Frame Buffer Size
genericSettings.why: NootedRed needs at least 512 MB of iGPU memory; 1 GB+ is recommended.
genericSettings.ifMissing: Many laptops hide it; update the BIOS or leave the default.

genericSettings.title: SVM / Virtualisation
genericSettings.why: Not used by macOS on AMD; leave as is.

genericSettings.title: Intel SGX
genericSettings.why: Not used by macOS; occasionally interferes with boot.

genericSettings.title: Serial / COM port
genericSettings.why: Legacy serial ports can interfere with macOS on desktops.

genericSettings.title: Save and exit
genericSettings.menuPath: Exit → Save Changes and Reset (usually F10)

models.setupNotes: Power on and immediately tap F1 repeatedly to enter ThinkPad Setup (Enter at the red logo shows the Startup Interrupt menu). Arrow keys move between tabs, Enter opens, F5/F6 change values, Esc goes back, F10 saves and exits.

settings.title: Secure Boot
settings.why: OpenCore is not signed with Microsoft keys.
settings.ifMissing: If greyed out, check 'Secure Boot Mode' isn't locked by your organisation.

settings.title: UEFI/Legacy Boot
settings.ifMissing: Some T495 BIOS versions are UEFI-only already.

settings.title: CSM Support
settings.why: CSM interferes with GOP graphics init.
settings.ifMissing: Hidden when 'UEFI Only' is selected — fine.

settings.title: UMA Frame Buffer Size
settings.menuPath: Config → Display → UMA Frame buffer Size
settings.why: NootedRed needs at least 512 MB of iGPU memory; 1 GB+ is recommended.
settings.ifMissing: Older BIOS releases may not show it. Update the BIOS first, or leave the default.

settings.title: Sleep State
settings.why: macOS expects S3 sleep; Windows 'Modern Standby' does not work in macOS.
settings.ifMissing: If missing, disable sleep after install.

settings.title: OS Optimized Defaults
settings.why: When enabled it forces Windows-oriented defaults (incl. Secure Boot on).

settings.title: Fingerprint Reader
settings.menuPath: Security → I/O Port Access → Fingerprint Reader
settings.why: Never works in macOS; disabling saves power.
settings.ifMissing: Skip if there is no reader.

settings.title: Device Guard
settings.why: Locks Secure Boot and virtualisation settings on when enabled.
settings.ifMissing: Not on most T495 BIOS versions.

models.setupNotes: Tap F1 at power-on for ThinkPad Setup (or Enter at the logo, then F1). F10 saves and exits.

settings.title: Secure Boot
settings.why: OpenCore is not signed with Microsoft keys.

settings.title: Sleep State
settings.why: macOS cannot use Windows Modern Standby.
settings.ifMissing: If missing, sleep will likely not work in macOS.

settings.title: Thunderbolt BIOS Assist / Security
settings.value: BIOS Assist: Disabled, Security: No Security
settings.ifMissing: Only on Intel ThinkPads with Thunderbolt.

settings.title: Fingerprint Reader
settings.menuPath: Security → I/O Port Access → Fingerprint Reader
